tasks.summary: Implemented GET /dramas pagination, search, and genre filtering with the common `{items,page,hasNext}` response. The controller rejects invalid scalar and bracket-form query keys; the service filters before fetching 31 rows, sorts by publishedAt/id descending, and enriches only the returned 30. Updated the drama API docs, pagination conventions, and backend README. All declared checks passed: lint; selected content and drama-pagination suites (15/54 and 37/20 requests/assertions); full backend test (25 files, 165 unit tests, all 11 HTTP suites); parallel API isolation; and build. Final diff scope and whitespace checks passed.
